pov: Imbila.AI is the consulting & IP arm to the 2nth.ai execution platform. For OpenAI we do not duplicate official material — we curate the best free, official sources and recommend them in a sensible order. Learning is on imbila.ai; building, models and infrastructure live on 2nth.ai.

resources.title: OpenAI Academy
resources.whenToUse: The best starting point for almost everyone — official courses, live sessions and videos for every level.

resources.title: ChatGPT
resources.whenToUse: Learn by using it on your real work — projects, custom GPTs, voice, vision, deep research.

resources.title: Prompt Engineering Guide
resources.whenToUse: When your results are inconsistent and you want reliable, structured output.

resources.title: OpenAI API Platform & Docs
resources.whenToUse: When you start building OpenAI into your own apps and need the full reference.

resources.title: OpenAI Cookbook
resources.whenToUse: When you want working code recipes for common API tasks.

resources.title: OpenAI Agents SDK
resources.whenToUse: When you are ready to build autonomous, multi-agent systems with tool use.

resources.title: GPT explainer (know.2nth.ai)
resources.whenToUse: For an independent, fact-checked deep-dive on how the GPT/OpenAI stack works and its trade-offs.

resources.title: Imbila Claude 4D Academy
resources.whenToUse: If they want a guided, interactive Imbila course (lessons + AI tutor + assessments) rather than self-serve links — this is our flagship, built on the 4D AI-Fluency framework.

resources.title: 2nth.ai
resources.whenToUse: When they have learned enough and want to actually build, deploy or run AI in production — that is the execution platform.
